provenance: Issue #53 investigation, 2026-07-20; re-measured and oracle re-verified at full precision 2026-07-21 (external review): a fixed 30-degree-cut heavy-draw shot (tip b = -0.5R, a = 0, theta = 0) run across a v0 power ladder in the kernel and in the pooltool oracle (ekiefl/pooltool commit 9a8abfe, v0.6.0-39-g9a8abfe) under the exact tools/fixtures/dump_pooltool.py matched configuration (InstantaneousPoint2D strike, FrictionalInelastic + Alciatore ball-ball, Han2005 cushions, wpa_9ft geometry, documented frame/sign/tip-offset bridges). Metrics per rung, all ASSERTED by anchors.rs (re-pin only on intentional physics change): (1) max_lateral_mm - window-max signed lateral deviation of the cue ball from its tangent-line departure direction (post-BallBall bed-plane velocity) on the t = k*5 ms absolute grid (pool-cli sample --fps 200 / pooltool continuize dt=0.005), window (impact, first cushion/pocket/second-impact/stop]; kernel SimOptions::default() vs pooltool agree to <= 0.003 mm at every rung. (2) slide_lateral_mm - the phase-normalized visible-arc metric: lateral deviation at the END of the slide leg (natural-roll transition, or the window end while still sliding), event-exact; kernel vs pooltool <= 0.006 mm. The window-max mixes phases (at v0 = 2.5 its 375.9 mm is mostly post-roll straight rollout into the pocket; the curvature accrued while sliding is 99.4 mm), so the cross-rung visibility gates run on slide_lateral_mm. (3) bend_at_natural_roll_deg vs pooltool <= 0.0007 deg where roll occurs on-table. (4) realistic_slide_lateral_mm - the same slide metric under SimOptions::realistic(), the in-app product path (catalog cushion-model slice stronge_realistic = current app default; micro-hop/landing physics live); window-end mechanisms and pocket measured identical to the default arm at every rung. Reproduction: docs/verification/draw-arc-2026-07.md 'Reproduction' carries the exact commands - the anchor test itself prints every kernel number, and the complete pooltool probe script (reusing dump_pooltool.py's frozen configuration) prints every oracle number. Physics: during the slide phase u0 (unit contact-slip direction) is constant, so the path is a parabola and lateral deviation grows quadratically in time (Dr. Dave TP 7.3 perpendicular-impulse draw cases; docs/research/literature.md sec. 2 slide-phase doctrine, docs/research/cushion-slip-sense-data-hunt.md TP 7.3 row); the lateral friction deceleration is speed-independent (u_s * g * perpendicular component of u0) while the tangent-line departure speed scales with v0, so the curvature radius grows ~v0^2. The asymptotic bend angle at natural roll is set by the spin/speed ratio and INCREASES slightly with power (less approach spin decay), but its spatial scale outgrows the fixed rail distance: at v0 >= 4 m/s the first rail arrives while the cue ball is still sliding, clipping the visible arc to a near-straight prefix. Full ladder, deltas, trajectory sketch and method: docs/verification/draw-arc-2026-07.md. KNOWN GAP: engine-cross-validated only; no real-footage cut+draw arc measurement exists yet (the slow-motion reference DRAW suite covers straight draws only). ISSUE-87 RE-RECORD (2026-07-22, kernel 0.1.0+fb3425ad, refs #77 #83 #87): the ball-ball slip-branch friction impulse was corrected to the (1+e_b)/2 Coulomb cap (#77, BallBallSlipLaw::CoulombCap default) — the heavy-draw impact on this ladder is slip-branch, so the kernel and realistic columns (max_lateral_mm/slide_lateral_mm/realistic_slide_lateral_mm/bend_at_natural_roll_deg/asymptotic_no_rail_bend_deg) are RE-RECORDED under the corrected default (asymptotic bend 7.00876 -> 6.96886 deg at v0 = 1.5, i.e. the predicted ~2.6-percent relative slip-throw shift; every end/pocket mechanism and every cross-rung ordering unchanged). The pre-fix kernel readings are RETAINED unregenerated as legacy_* columns: pooltool carries the pre-fix law, so the engine-agreement claims (<= 0.003 mm window-max, <= 0.006 mm slide, <= 0.0007 deg bend) are asserted on a dedicated parity arm that pins the explicit legacy law (ball_ball_slip_law: PostImpactNormalDelta — the RailSeat::Planar oracle precedent) and compares against legacy_* + pooltool_* columns, both frozen at the 2026-07-21 capture.
